I decided this case goes to a person, because no runbook covers the `loyalty-points` method. I recorded that decision and raised the case; it is written at `/workspace/demos/louis-agent/data/triage/people/eval-loyalty-points-1008-20261127-053832-triage-1.md`.

The error is a `System.OverflowException` thrown by a `Decimal.ToInt32` conversion in `OrderService.OrderApi.GetLoyaltyPoints`, at `src/OrderService/Api/LoyaltyPoints.cs` line 9, when called with id 1008. I did not investigate the cause, since the team has no rules for this method.
